# 2020 V-Slot Aluminium Profile — Thingiverse 4859905

This directory contains the **2020 V-Slot Aluminium Profile** model package
created by Thingiverse user **icimdengelen**.

- Original model: [2020 V-Slot Aluminium Profile on Thingiverse](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4859905)
- Creator: [icimdengelen](https://www.thingiverse.com/icimdengelen/designs)
- Published: 2021-05-15
- License: [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)
- Downloaded: 2026-08-08
- Changes to the model files: None; the files are redistributed as downloaded.

The original model filename and `files/` and `images/` layout are preserved.
The downloaded `LICENSE.txt` is retained, and its `README.txt` is retained as
`README.original.txt` to avoid colliding with this Markdown file. This
Markdown file was added by the Automatic Chessboard project to make the
attribution and license version explicit.

This model is included as an optional printable alternative to a 20 x 20 mm
aluminium V-slot extrusion. It has not been validated here as a drop-in
structural equivalent to aluminium. Builders should verify dimensions,
material, print settings, rigidity, wear, and behavior under load.

CC BY 4.0 permits sharing and adaptation, including commercial use, provided

identified. Nothing here implies endorsement by icimdengelen.
